criteria.blue: Only a demonstrated same underlying estimate with a display-only discrepancy: documented different rounding conventions at a mathematically established half-unit boundary, verified intermediate/double rounding, or harmless binary representation at that same boundary. A +/-0.01 change alone is insufficient.
criteria.black: Identical published and replicated displayed value and significance. Matching rounded values do not establish equal unrounded estimates.
criteria.red: Any unresolved change in estimated magnitude, sample, model, target, test, p-value realization, or significance assignment. Monte Carlo-compatible changes are explicitly labeled stochastic rather than described as substantive scientific disagreement.
criteria.monte_carlo: Different random draws produce different unrounded p-values. Even when they round to adjacent cent values or change a threshold star, they are not rounding-only. Require identical unrounded p to label formatting-only.
criteria.stars: The supplied randomization_test.R computes p<=.10/.05/.01 stars before sprintf("%.2f",p). Therefore a star change cannot be attributed solely to printing p to two decimals.
criteria.pending: T11 and TB14 classifications apply only to the present snapshot and must be refreshed after their estimator/data investigations; possible new half-cent cases are tracked separately.
